​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​Working Party 5C (WP 5C) - Fixed wireless systems; HF systems in the fixed and land mobile services

WP 5C is responsible for studies related to fixed wireless systems and HF systems in the fixed and land mobile services. It studies performance and availability objectives, interference criteria, RF channel/block arrangements, system characteristics and sharing feasibility. (Note that for fixed wireless access (FWA) systems, work related to public access systems for potentially large deployment coverage is carried out in WP 5A.)
